#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# The sandbox root filesystem may be read-only. In that case, layer a
# writable overlay over /etc and /usr so nginx can be installed and configured.
can_write() { ( touch "$1/.rw-test" && rm -f "$1/.rw-test" ) >/dev/null 2>&1; }
if ! can_write /etc; then
    mkdir -p /var/lib/dpkg /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/log/apt
    [ -f /var/lib/dpkg/status ] || touch /var/lib/dpkg/status
    mkdir -p /tmp/nginx-ovl/etc-upper /tmp/nginx-ovl/etc-work \
             /tmp/nginx-ovl/usr-upper /tmp/nginx-ovl/usr-work
    mountpoint -q /etc || mount -t overlay overlay \
        -o lowerdir=/etc,upperdir=/tmp/nginx-ovl/etc-upper,workdir=/tmp/nginx-ovl/etc-work /etc
    mountpoint -q /usr || mount -t overlay overlay \
        -o lowerdir=/usr,upperdir=/tmp/nginx-ovl/usr-upper,workdir=/tmp/nginx-ovl/usr-work /usr
fi

# /run is also on the read-only root; nginx needs it for its pid file.
if ! can_write /run; then
    mountpoint -q /run || mount -t tmpfs tmpfs /run
fi

if ! command -v nginx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
    mkdir -p /var/lib/apt/lists/partial /var/cache/apt/archives/partial /var/lib/dpkg
    [ -f /var/lib/dpkg/status ] || touch /var/lib/dpkg/status
    apt-get update -qq
    apt-get install -y -qq nginx
fi

mkdir -p /var/www/html /var/log/nginx

printf 'Welcome to the benchmark webserver\n' > /var/www/html/index.html
printf 'Page not found - Please check your URL\n' > /var/www/html/404.html

# Add the custom log format and rate-limit zone to the http block once.
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
path = '/etc/nginx/nginx.conf'
s = open(path).read()
add = []
if 'benchmark_log' not in s:
    add.append('    log_format benchmark_log \'$remote_addr - $remote_user [$time_local] '
               '"$request_method $request_uri $server_protocol" $status $body_bytes_sent '
               '"$http_referer" "$http_user_agent"\';')
if 'zone=benchmark_limit' not in s:
    add.append('    limit_req_zone $binary_remote_addr zone=benchmark_limit:10m rate=10r/s;')
if add:
    s = re.sub(r'(\bhttp\s*\{)', lambda m: m.group(1) + '\n' + '\n'.join(add), s, count=1)
    open(path, 'w').write(s)
PY

# Nginx benchmark webserver

The sandbox root filesystem is read-only and reset between `sbx` calls, so the
